verdict.rationale: Lithic's Authorization Rules Engine (v2) supports defining conditional rules at program/account/card level, including custom TypeScript-to-WASM logic, shadow mode testing, backtesting, and real-time enforcement on the authorization event stream — a clear rules-trigger-action automation system. Webhooks/Events API and ASA further allow custom event-driven actions via HTTP callbacks. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification beyond vendor docs, and more detail on the breadth of trigger types beyond authorization events.
